C0170.title: Self-Developed Game Cheat Earns 200,000 Yuan, Developer Sentenced to Three Years
C0170.summary: A Tencent News repost used the headline 'self-developed cheat earned 200,000 yuan and resulted in a three-year sentence.' The article presented game-cheat production and sale as one of the week's game-law cases, indicating that cheat development, sales, and monetization can trigger criminal liability, and that platforms need to detect automated cheating tools, cheat transactions, and paid distribution chains. Risk controls should also watch cheat resellers, license-code sales, and clusters of abnormal player behavior.
